# 🏪 KrishiAI — Vendor Ecosystem & Capabilities

## 1. Overview
The **Vendor Ecosystem** enables agricultural buyers, input dealers, logistics providers, and cold storage warehouses to operate on a unified portal.

## 2. Key Modules
- **Procurement & Bidding Engine**: Create bulk crop buying requirements and receive direct farmer bids.
- **Real-Time Price Negotiation**: Counter-offer and settle crop pricing in live chat rooms.
- **AI Grain Grading & Quality Inspection**: Compute automated grain moisture and foreign matter grades with instant payout calculations.
- **Logistics & Doorstep Fleet Tracking**: Assign drivers, generate waybills, and monitor dispatch routes.
- **Agri-Input Marketplace**: Direct-to-farmer ecommerce for certified seeds, bio-fertilizers, and machinery.

## 3. Directory Layout
```
vendor/
├── profile/        # Vendor domain profile schemas and sample datasets
├── files/          # APMC licenses, GST certificates, and product image uploads
└── constants/      # Document types, quality grading criteria, and fee structures
```
